## tmleMulti

Targeted Maximum Likelihood Estimation for multicausal treatment effects
in the potential outcomes framework. Supports multivalued treatments with
Super Learner nuisance estimation, cross-fitting, and
influence-function-based variance estimation, alongside competitor
estimators (Double Machine Learning, overlap-weighted IPW, and
G-computation).

- Package source: [github.com/migariane/tmleMulti](https://github.com/migariane/tmleMulti)
- Reference documentation: [migariane.github.io/tmleMulti](https://migariane.github.io/tmleMulti)

**Authors:** co-authored by Gustavo Rivas Gervilla (PhD student, this
group) and Miguel Ángel Luque Fernández (senior author).
